newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy car market up 40 pct in April -Fiat.
newsitem.headline: Italy car market up 40 pct in April -Fiat.

text.p: The managing director of Fiat Auto, part of car giant Fiat SpA, said on Monday the Italian car market had grown by more than 40 percent in April compared with the same month last year.
Roberto Pestore told a news conference that the Italian market "has grown a great deal, certainly more than 40 percent" compared with April 1996.
Auto sector analysts said earlier that Italian new car registrations should show a rise of 25-30 percent year-on-year in April.
Official data is due to be published by the Transport Ministry on Friday May 9 or Saturday May 10.
Registrations in April 1996 totalled 151,905. In March this year, they jumped 25.04 percent to 220,500, boosted by a government car buying incentive scheme introduced in January.
